row:
Massage therapy has plenty of good, some bad, and a lot of stuff nobody tells you.
I’ve spent more than 16 years working throughout the massage industry, from spas, private practice to massage schools and the corporate side of the business. This channel is where I share the practical advice, honest conversations and blunt opinions I wish more therapists heard at the beginning of their careers.
The Blunt LMT is for future massage therapists, students, newer LMTs, experienced therapists and anyone curious about what really happens behind the treatment-room door. We’ll talk about massage school, practical interviews, draping, clients, confidence, finding a job, body mechanics, career longevity, industry myths and everything that happens after graduation. And because I’m a massage therapist who cannot draw, Nova, my AI artist, helps bring The Blunt LMT to life. The artwork may be AI-created, but the experience, education and blunt opinions come from a real person
Subscribe and come along.
